title: Find declared-link reassessment after code and requirement-only changes
preconditions: Use shopSaga with story pay, design queue-design and a charge quality definition verifying pay/charged. Use separate branches for a queue code change and story r2 wording change.

steps.action: Change queue behavior and reconcile against main.
steps.expected_result: The queue includes a story reassessment and the stale evidence repair.

steps.action: Change only story pay wording/criterion and reconcile.
steps.expected_result: No code change/currency staleness is fabricated; queue includes story, design, relation and test case, with traceability inspection and relation-repin route.

steps.action: Inspect Because on each implicated record.
steps.expected_result: Each reassessment names the declaring relation or requirement-change cause, and unrelated records are not claimed as impacted.

expected_result: Reassessment follows declared links even when the change contains no source edits.
